title: Hospital: typed pre-round summary with labs, an overnight event and a plan topic fills the panels, tracker and tasks
goal: Open the chart of {hospitalPatient} on the Pre-Round tab. Open the pre-round notes editor and type this text into the pre-round observations box exactly as written (typing stands in for dictation): "Pre-round review for today, written from the morning list before rounds. 72-year-old man with COPD and hypertension admitted with community-acquired pneumonia. Overnight he spiked to 38.6, blood cultures were drawn, no rigors. This morning BP 124/72, HR 98, RR 20, O2 93% on 2 L. Labs: WBC 15.1 up from 12.4, creatinine 1.3, lactate 1.8. Chest X-ray shows the right lower lobe infiltrate unchanged. On ceftriaxone 1 g IV daily and azithromycin 500 mg daily, day 2. Home Toprol XL 50 mg daily, continue the metoprolol succinate. Plan: discuss switching to oral antibiotics tomorrow, follow up the blood cultures, repeat CBC in the morning." Press Save Note and wait until the editor closes and the panels below it update. Save checkpoint 1 with the Pre-Round panels visible. Open the Encounter tab, wait until its Tasks list stops changing (up to 30 seconds) and save checkpoint 2. Open the Post-Round tab, open its Medication Tracker and save checkpoint 3.
